description: This file defines additional mock actions for Google Mock, including classes and templates for invoking functions and methods, and various mock action macros.

classes.name: InvokeAction
classes.description: Implements the Invoke(f) action, which calls a function or functor with given arguments.

classes.name: InvokeMethodAction
classes.description: Implements the Invoke(object_ptr, &Class::Method) action to call a method on an object.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Creates an action that invokes a function or functor with mock arguments.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Creates an action that invokes a method on an object with mock arguments.

methods.name: WithoutArgs
methods.description: Creates an action that performs an inner action ignoring the mock function's arguments.

methods.name: WithArg
methods.description: Creates an action passing the k-th argument to another action.

methods.name: ReturnArg
methods.description: Returns the k-th argument of the mock function.

methods.name: SaveArg
methods.description: Saves the k-th argument of the mock function to a pointer.

methods.name: SaveArgPointee
methods.description: Saves the value pointed to by the k-th argument to a pointer.

methods.name: SetArgReferee
methods.description: Assigns a value to the variable referenced by the k-th argument.

methods.name: SetArrayArgument
methods.description: Copies elements into the array pointed to by the k-th argument.

methods.name: DeleteArg
methods.description: Deletes the k-th argument of the mock function.

methods.name: ReturnPointee
methods.description: Returns the value pointed to by a pointer.

methods.name: Throw
methods.description: Throws an exception in a mock function.
